en: A multi-view color postcard with a blue border. The front features three main photographs and one small circular inset. The top image shows a modern terraced concrete building on a hillside. The middle image presents a central square with formal flower beds and paths; in the background stands a large stone building with a green dome (the former mosque in the main square), surrounded by historic facades and a statue. The bottom image shows a large modern housing or civic complex with white façades and multiple stories, set behind a landscaped park. The reverse side is a standard unused postcard layout with address lines and stamp boxes, printed text identifying the place and publisher details.
